analysis.title: Lev Fin Weekend Reading + Observations: adult swim (25 Oct 2026)
key_insights: The S&P 500 finished the week down 0.5%, but Thursday saw the largest wave of equity long selling in more than a year. Hedge funds de-grossed on seven of eight sessions, and the GS Risk Appetite Indicator had one of its largest daily drops on record.
Credit spreads widened slightly (HY +6bps, IG +5bps). Valuations remain tight on a post-2007 lookback (HY 23rd percentile, IG 13th).
The GS 30y IG hyperscaler basket widened 17bps WoW, its worst week on record outside of similar moves in July. Triple-C bonds finished the week at an average OAS of +1127, a new four-year wide.
44% of the S&P 500's market cap reports this week, and central bank decisions are also due.
Lev Fin remains split into three segments: generics, the AI universe and lower-quality credits.

Generics: HY has logged seven weekly losses in eight weeks, with mutual fund flows negative in six of the last seven weeks. Trading flows are still constructive outside triple-Cs, and 40.1% of junk bonds trade inside +200bps OAS, unchanged over three weeks.
13 of the 14 tranches priced in October trade above their OIDs, up an average of 1.6pts.
AI universe: USD HY AI-related spreads widened 78bps over two weeks to a new high of 400bps over Treasuries. Non-AI spreads excluding triple-Cs are 22bps wider over the same period.
The GS HY AI datacenter basket (GSHYAIDC) fell roughly 1pt last week. There has been no new HY AI deal month to date, ahead of an expected active 2027 AI issuance year.

Lower-quality credits: 88.2% of triple-Cs by notional are lower over 60 days, 70.6% are down 7-12pts and 22.5% are down 10-30pts. Triple-C daily moves run 3.3x double-Bs, and their spreads are 5.5x as wide.
The 20 worst triple-C bonds are down an average of 14.3pts in October, which is 49% of the bucket's total points lost. The other 185 triple-C bonds are down an average of 1.6pts.
59% of the HY market reports by the end of November. Two of the five largest issuer decliners in October are single-B: JBLU's bond is down 34pts MTD and FMC's B+ bond is down 25pts.

GIR notes aggregate HY fundamentals were solid through Q2 but triple-C issuer metrics stayed weak. The author says the rise in yields suggests fundamental improvement among performing issuers is likely to stall.

Investors still have cash to deploy, but it faces competing options: upcoming IG AI debt, low-vol well-known credits, or selective beaten-down triple-Cs. The author says all rating segments have minimal room for error.
Issuers are leaning toward callable paper as rates rise: 16 bond-to-loan transfers YTD totaling $3.7bn, three of them last week.
16 loan deals have launched or cleared with amortization above the standard 1% a year, the highest count since 2021.
US real estate stocks are at their lowest ever relative to the S&P 500. Private investors own about 70% of US debt, the most in more than 35 years, with nearly 10% from hedge funds.
Nvidia's market cap of $5.08tn is over $1.5tn more than all Russell 2000 companies combined.

market_movers.rationale: Listed as a must-read GS upgrade to Buy. The stated reason is that NTM datapoints on contract economics are likely to be more positive than the market expects.
